caseName: Fillmore v. Ind. Bell Tel. Co.
caseNameFull: Christopher W. FILLMORE v. INDIANA BELL TELEPHONE COMPANY, INC.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until January 28, 2019, within which *862to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
